entities.summary: Bolívar, Independence, and the Battle of Boyacá, a transformative movement in Colombia (1810–1819). Emerged from July 20, 1810 uprising in Bogotá — Colombian independence day and Battle of Boyacá — Bolívar defeats royalists, August 7, 1819. Catalyzed Congress of Cúcuta — Gran Colombia constitution, 1821.
